QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_21

question.text: Compliance with SAS is mandatory under the SEBI framework for social impact assessments conducted for:

answer.text: All Indian NPOs regardless of SSE listing
Only Section 8 Companies with annual turnover above INR 100 crore
Social enterprises listed on the Social Stock Exchange (SSE)
Only CSR programmes of the top 500 listed companies

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.117 states that compliance with SAS is a mandatory requirement for social impact assessments conducted for social enterprises listed on the Social Stock Exchange. Workbook p.118 adds that the SAS framework may also be applied to CSR or similar engagements, but that application is not mandatory. The Trap: A overshoots by requiring SAS for all NPOs regardless of SSE listing. B invents a turnover threshold not in the source. D conflates the SAS mandate with the CSR rule 8(3) impact-assessment trigger, which is a different obligation. Note: The mandatory-versus-optional distinction is the key takeaway: SSE-listed SE engagements must comply with SAS; other engagements may apply the framework voluntarily.
